[8Related Glyphs](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Shockwave#Related_Glyphs) ## Description | | | | --- | --- | | [![Shockwave.png](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/images/6/65/Shockwave.png)](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/File:Shockwave.png) | A spell that strikes the surrounding areas with bolts of lightning and blows all of the nearby enemies away. Must be equipped with a Wand or a Staff to use it. You need to recharge your MP to create bolts of lightning. However, there's also a chance to charge the skill when you get hit by a physical attack. | ## Details - Requires a [Wand](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Wands_List "Wands List") or [Staff](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Staves_List "Staves List") to use. - If used with a staff, it will reset all elemental charges to 0, even if the staff is charged with lightning. - Instantly casts a wave of electricity in a circle around the user, pushing all enemies back and knocking them down. - [Assault Slash](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Assault_Slash "Assault Slash") can be used as a follow-up. - Damage is distance-based. The farther away the center of target's hit box is from the user, the less damage is done. - Targets closer to the player will be hit sooner than targets farther from the player. - Can be used while stunned. - Getting hit by any physical attack has a chance to reset Shockwave's cooldown to 0, allowing it to be cast again immediately. - This includes getting [countered](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Counterattack "Counterattack") by an enemy and getting attacked with [Defense](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Defense "Defense") loaded. - The player does not need a wand or staff equipped in order for the reset to occur. - The skill icon will appear on the screen briefly and a lightning effect will occur when the cooldown is successfully reset by an enemy attack. - Shockwave is Lightning-based and is affected by [Lightning Mastery](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Lightning_Mastery "Lightning Mastery"). - Cannot be shunted by [Lightning Shield](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Lightning_Shield "Lightning Shield") and will still force the user to be knocked down by Shockwave. - Unlike most skills, Shockwave uses a percentage of the user's maximum Mana based on the skill's rank, rather than a fixed number. ## Summary | Rank | N | F | E | D | C | B | A | 9 | 8 | 7 | 6 | 5 | 4 | 3 | 2 | 1 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Required AP | - Description

 A spell that strikes the surrounding areas with bolts of lightning and blows all of the nearby enemies away. Must be equipped with a Wand or a Staff to use it. You need to recharge your MP to create bolts of lightning. However, there's also a chance to charge the skill when you get hit by a physical attack.

Details

  • Requires a Wand or Staff to use.
    • If used with a staff, it will reset all elemental charges to 0, even if the staff is charged with lightning.
  • Instantly casts a wave of electricity in a circle around the user, pushing all enemies back and knocking them down.
    • Assault Slash can be used as a follow-up.
    • Damage is distance-based. The farther away the center of target's hit box is from the user, the less damage is done.
    • Targets closer to the player will be hit sooner than targets farther from the player.
    • Can be used while stunned.
  • Getting hit by any physical attack has a chance to reset Shockwave's cooldown to 0, allowing it to be cast again immediately.
    • This includes getting countered by an enemy and getting attacked with Defense loaded.
    • The player does not need a wand or staff equipped in order for the reset to occur.
    • The skill icon will appear on the screen briefly and a lightning effect will occur when the cooldown is successfully reset by an enemy attack.
  • Shockwave is Lightning-based and is affected by Lightning Mastery.
  • Cannot be shunted by Lightning Shield and will still force the user to be knocked down by Shockwave.
  • Unlike most skills, Shockwave uses a percentage of the user's maximum Mana based on the skill's rank, rather than a fixed number.

Obtaining the Skill

Complete the [Learn Shockwave] quest after reaching Apprentice Sage.

How to Get Quest

Acquire Apprentice Level or higher in Sage Talent (Apprentice Level Magic and Apprentice Level Holy Arts)

Briefing Your skills with combat magic have grown significantly. Perhaps you are ready to learn a new technique. Are you interested? - Berched

Training Method

  • "Succeed in resetting cooldown" can be easily trained by using Enthralling Performance on White Spiders in Tir Chonaill's Graveyard, or the Brown Foxes near the Healer's House in Tir Chonaill, and then letting them attack you after Enthralling Performance ends, or cancels.
    • This is also a good method for "Attack 2 or more enemies."
    • PvP can be used to repeatedly reset the cooldown of the skill; this only allows training for the "Use the skill" requirement, however.
